subject.title: [Feature Request] Session List: Show timestamp + last message preview

question: Should the narrow Control UI Sessions-list preview land independently, or be folded into broader Sessions overview work?
rationale: The backend and TUI already support last-message previews, but the visible Control UI table design overlaps with open broader issues about overview, titles, sorting, and peek behavior.

options.title: Land Narrow Preview
options.body: Repair or replace #48396 with a focused implementation that uses includeLastMessage, adds the UI row field, renders a compact preview, and adds targeted tests.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Overview
options.body: Keep this issue linked to the broader overview direction and close the narrow PR only after naming the canonical design issue.

options.title: Defer Preview UI
options.body: Leave the Sessions table as a technical management view for now and close the paired PR with a maintainer-stated UX rationale.

recommendation.title: Land Narrow Preview
recommendation.body: Repair or replace #48396 with a focused implementation that uses includeLastMessage, adds the UI row field, renders a compact preview, and adds targeted tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cross-surface Sessions work makes this the clearest available owner for the UI/product choice.
